@copilot Update this PR directly with the following behavior-preserving simplification of the temporary delta-preferred exporter implementation. Keep the PR's existing draft state and base. Do not create another PR.

1. In testing-common/src/main/java/io/opentelemetry/instrumentation/testing/internal/DeltaPreferredInMemoryMetricExporter.java, remove the NoClassDefFoundError/NoSuchMethodError fallback and its duplicated instrument-type mapping. Delegate temporality directly to AggregationTemporalitySelector.deltaPreferred(). That SDK selector already exists in version 1.14.0, the release that introduced InMemoryMetricExporter. The repository's supported pinned testing SDKs, including 1.27 and 1.66, do not require this fallback. Keep the wrapper as small delegation to the SDK in-memory exporter, preserving raw MetricData storage, getters, reset, flush, and shutdown.

2. In testing/agent-exporter/src/main/java/io/opentelemetry/javaagent/testing/exporter/OtlpInMemoryMetricExporter.java, use one initialized AggregationTemporalitySelector. With no otel.javaagent.testing.exporter.temporality property, use deltaPreferred(). With an explicitly configured DELTA or CUMULATIVE, parse the enum case-insensitively as today and return a constant selector for that enum. Remove the separate default selector, hasAggregationTemporalityOverride boolean, and placeholder DELTA override. getAggregationTemporality should only delegate to the initialized selector. Preserve invalid-value failure, useful CONFIG logging, and all OTLP capture/lifecycle behavior. Explicit DELTA must still mean DELTA for every instrument type, not delta-preferred.

3. Add one concise TODO on the shared adapter identifying when it can be removed and linking to https://github.com/open-telemetry/opentelemetry-java/pull/8993. Suggested wording: "TODO: Replace this adapter with the SDK selector overload once all supported test runtimes provide it: https://github.com/open-telemetry/opentelemetry-java/pull/8993". The upstream PR adds InMemoryMetricExporter.create(AggregationTemporalitySelector), but it is not released yet. Do not upgrade SDK dependencies or replace the wrapper with the unreleased overload now. No TODO is needed on the agent exporter, which must continue storing OTLP requests.

Retain the existing emitted-data regression tests and separate-JVM DELTA/CUMULATIVE override coverage. They validate our library/installed-agent wiring and external setting independently of upstream SDK tests and should remain after adapter removal. Keep shared library, Spring starter, and declarative provider paths consistent. Do not add normalization, new abstractions, broad migrations, or unrelated changes.

Apply narrow relevant Spotless formatting before running focused tests. Validate the Micrometer long-task timer/default temporality cases and testing:agent-for-testing's default, testTemporalityDelta, and testTemporalityCumulative paths. Validate relevant shared/starter compilation and supported SDK compatibility as needed. Do not clean, disable caches, or force reruns. Include the repository's required Co-authored-by: Copilot App <223556219+Copilot@users.noreply.github.com> trailer in coding commits.

replies.body: Updated in commit `0f1b60a1`: the shared adapter now delegates directly to `deltaPreferred()` and has the removal TODO; the agent exporter initializes one default-or-override selector. Focused Micrometer tests and default/DELTA/CUMULATIVE agent tests passed.

In testing-common/src/main/java/io/opentelemetry/instrumentation/testing/internal/DeltaPreferredInMemoryMetricExporter.java, move the adapter-removal TODO from the delegate field to the class-level Javadoc alongside the internal-API notice. Preserve all current user changes, including the applied simplification of docs/contributing/javaagent-test-infra.md. @copilot Update this PR directly with the agreed test reduction. Preserve its existing draft state and base. Do not create another PR.

Reduce both testing-common/src/test/java/io/opentelemetry/instrumentation/testing/DeltaPreferredMetricTemporalityTest.java and testing/agent-for-testing/src/test/java/io/opentelemetry/javaagent/testing/AgentMetricTemporalityTest.java to two representative instruments: a regular counter and an observable up-down counter. Remove the observable-counter, synchronous up-down-counter, and histogram setup and assertions, their unused imports, and obsolete cleanup. The SDK owns the full instrument-selection matrix; these tests should verify our real library/installed-agent wiring and the repeated-value regression rather than repeat that matrix.

Keep all three actual metric collections in each test, with the observable up-down value 1 for the first two collections and 0 for the third. Assert the full exported observable history only after the third collection. Remove the redundant first- and second-history assertions, not the collections themselves. Retain one counter-temporality assertion and one observable up-down-temporality assertion using the first collection. For the library/default path, the counter must be DELTA and the observable up-down counter CUMULATIVE with final history exactly 1, 1, 0. In the installed-agent test, default must produce the same temporalities/history; explicit DELTA must make both instruments DELTA and produce exactly 1, 0, -1; explicit CUMULATIVE must make both CUMULATIVE and produce exactly 1, 1, 0. Continue closing the observable instrument.

Retain separate library and installed-agent test classes and their actual runner/exporter collection paths. Keep the separate-JVM default/DELTA/CUMULATIVE runs, including the lowercase override settings that exercise case-insensitive parsing. Do not introduce a new shared test abstraction or additional helper solely to compute these short expected values. Adjust a test name if its reference to every instrument becomes inaccurate. Keep the change limited to these test reductions; no production, dependency, documentation, SDK, Gradle task wiring, normalization, or Micrometer changes are requested. Preserve all existing user edits and the class-level TODO and field organization.

Apply the narrowest relevant Spotless tasks directly before behavioral validation. Run the focused shared-runner test and the installed-agent default, testTemporalityDelta, and testTemporalityCumulative cases. Do not clean, bypass caches, or force reruns.
